comparison.objective: Mount an ASTM dogbone specimen in two spring-closed tensile-test grips at the specified gauge length.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold-open insertion into opposed wedge grips, crosshead jogging, and straight specimen alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Both tabs seated with end gaps, levers closed, 115±5 mm jaw spacing, specimen within 2°, grippers clear for 3 s.
comparison.reason: Tests bilateral clamping and metrology setup, not selective separation through openings.
